bio: Considered the informal little brother to Ancestral, which can be found on the upper floor and boasting a MICHELIN Star, everything here is designed for sharing (among the starters, don't miss the pickled mussels), with the grill at its core. The ‘Viandas y chacinas’ (Prepared dishes and charcuterie) section stands out, as well as its selection of meats, with select cuts (Wagyu beef tomahawk, Angus sirloin, black angus entrails...) and maturities to suit all tastes. The accompaniments are served separately!
